text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"...In the corner of the photo, a man in 
traditional Japanese attire. It is said he 
was a samurai once betrayed by his master, 
and his lingering grudge turned him into 
an earthbound spirit—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, those eyes are terrifying...! Crap, 
looking at her might literally curse me to 
death...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, isn't Alv-san amazing? She's not 
scared one bit. She really is so cool..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't let anyone see... Not when I'm 
looking so weak...!)
